title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn, Feb 13, 2027
description: An American Hymn is a Springfield Symphony Orchestra concert of religious works by American composers, built around reflection on the sacred and holy. The program includes Leonard Bernstein's Chichester Psalms, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring with its Shaker hymn Simple Gifts, and Jessie Montgomery's Starburst. It takes place Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
